danny.audio_profile: Danny, a regular guy in his late thirties. He is genuinely a little scared and still shaken, and he tells what happened plainly and honestly, in a natural voice with very little inflection, keeping his pitch fairly level and even, like a real person, not an actor.

marcus.audio_profile: Marcus, 22, a big, easygoing young man with a deep voice, talking low into his walkie-talkie.

marcus_gate.audio_profile: Marcus, 22, a big, easygoing young man with a deep voice. He is badly hurt and worn out, sitting against the bars of a store gate in the dark, talking to his best friend on the other side. He still sounds like himself, warm and a little funny.

vera.audio_profile: Vera, a woman in her forties. Calm, warm and funny, and she never raises her voice. She sounds friendly and in control, which is what makes her frightening.

broadcast.audio_profile: An official announcer reading a recorded emergency alert, steady, clear and unhurried.

scene: A man quietly tells what happened during the first hour of a zombie outbreak at the mall where he works. Close to the microphone, plain and natural, no music.
sample_context: A first-person story told plainly, in a natural, slightly scared voice.
